messages:
maria (CS): Heads-up — Orbiton dedicated bring-up is scheduled for Tue 09:00 PT. Need final agreement on quota windows, autoscale thresholds, and a short smoke load test window. Can ops/infra confirm a safe ramp plan?

devon (SRE): We can do a stepped ramp: 5m warmup at 10% qps, 10m at 30%, 15m at 60%, then 30m soak at target. Autoscale policy we propose: scale-up on 95th pct CPU or queue > 2000ms for 3m, scale-down after 10m stable below 60%.

luca (Infra): Agree with stepped ramp. Add KV cache priming step before traffic (5 min of small prefix-heavy requests) to avoid cold-kv spikes. Also we'll pin model variant to v1.3-quant during the first 24h for predictability.

ana (Solutions): Orbiton expects bursty batch imports after the first hour — plan needs a short headroom allowance for that (2x for 5m). Also they want visibility: can we provide a per-route latency dashboard link for them?

maria (CS): @luca can you confirm the model pinning? @devon can you add the headroom rule to the autoscale policy? I will ask Orbiton to avoid batch imports until after ramp unless we signal go.

luca (Infra): Confirmed: model pinned to v1.3-quant for 24h, then auto-roll to fallback if regressions detected. I'll create a short note in the ticket.

devon (SRE): Adding headroom: temporary surge multiplier = 2.0 for 5m if traffic spike detected within first 90m post-cutover. Patching autoscale JSON now:

```
{"scale_up_when": "cpu_95pct>0.95 or queue_ms>2000","cooldown_up": "3m","scale_down_when": "cpu_5pct<0.6","cooldown_down": "10m","temporary_surge": {"multiplier": 2.0, "window": "5m", "enabled_until": "90m_post_cutover"}}
```

maria (CS): Nice. ops question: who will trigger the smoke run?

deploy-bot: Ticket CS-4872 created: Orbiton bringup orchestration. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-4872

ana (Solutions): I'll trigger the smoke sessions and coordinate with Orbiton's SRE. Plan: smoke at 09:20 PT (after the warmup + priming). We'll do a short synthetic of 50 synthetic users hitting chat + embeddings routes.

devon (SRE): For the smoke, recommend this quick curl command to simulate traffic (sends mixed chat+embed):

```
for i in {1..50}; do curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate -d '{"route":"chat","prompt":"ping"}'; sleep 0.5; done
```

maria (CS): Thanks. I'll lock the customer to the 09:20 smoke and ask them to hold batch imports. Also creating a short runbook snippet: rollback trigger = persistent >5% error rate for 10m or latency p95 > 3s for 15m.

luca (Infra): Copy that. We'll keep an emergency fallback model (v1.2-fp16) ready and stand by in the control plane.

maria (CS): Great — next steps: 1) devon paste autoscale JSON in CS-4872, 2) luca add model pin + fallback note, 3) ana coordinate smoke with Orbiton, 4) I'll send the runbook and confirm times. Aim to close prep by EOD today. :thumbsup:

ana (Solutions): On it. Will update ticket when Orbiton confirms hold window.

devon (SRE): Autoscale JSON posted to CS-4872.

luca (Infra): Model pin added and fallback documented.

maria (CS): Perfect — thanks team. I'll post a short summary to the customer channel once Orbiton acknowledges.

ana (Solutions): Orbiton confirmed hold. All set for Tue. :rocket:
